description_en: Generates a single-product showcase video for e-commerce merchants and platforms based on a product title and multiple images of the same product. This API optionally accepts a storyboard script, automatically selects reference images, plans a three-shot storyboard, and generates the video. It uses asynchronous tasks, supports 720P and 1080P resolutions and four aspect ratios, and applies to product content production for non-apparel categories. For apparel categories, use the e-commerce enhanced edition
description_zh: 电商视频基础版面向电商商家与平台，根据商品标题、同一商品的多张图片，可选输入分镜脚本，自动选择参考图、规划三段分镜并生成单商品展示视频。接口采用异步任务方式，支持 720P、1080P 分辨率和四种画幅，适用于非服饰类目的商品内容生产。服饰类目使用电商增强版
name: ProductVideoGeneration

parameters.help_en: The product title. This parameter is required
parameters.name: product_title

parameters.help_en: The public image URLs. At least one image URL is required. Each URL must start with http:// or https:// after leading and trailing whitespaces are removed
parameters.help_zh: 公网图片 URL，至少一张；每一项去掉首尾空白后必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
parameters.name: product_images

parameters.help_en: The existing storyboard script. If this parameter is not provided or is left blank, automatic planning is used
parameters.help_zh: 已有脚本；不传或只有空白时走自动规划
parameters.name: script

parameters.help_en: The video duration in seconds. Default value: 15. If no script is provided, the value must be an integer from 5 to 15. If a script is provided, the value must be an integer from 5 to 30. A value of 15.0 is treated as 15
parameters.help_zh: 秒，默认 15；无脚本取值 5～15 的整数，有脚本取值 5～30 的整数；15.0 视为 15
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: The aspect ratio. Default value: 9:16. Valid values: 16:9, 1:1, 3:4, and 9:16
parameters.name: aspect_ratio

parameters.help_en: The resolution. Default value: 720P. Valid values: 720P and 1080P. The value is case-insensitive and is automatically converted to uppercase by the service
parameters.help_zh: 默认 720P；允许 720P、1080P；大小写不敏感，服务统一转成大写
parameters.name: resolution

route.description_en: The planning route written upon acceptance. Valid values: DIRECT (with script) and AUTO_PLAN (automatic planning)
route.description_zh: 受理时写入的 DIRECT 或 AUTO_PLAN
route.title_en: 规划路径：DIRECT（有脚本）或 AUTO_PLAN（自动规划）
route.title_zh: 规划路径：DIRECT（有脚本）或 AUTO_PLAN（自动规划）

status.title_en: 任务状态，受理成功固定 PENDING
status.title_zh: 任务状态，受理成功固定 PENDING

task_id.description_en: The task ID of this service

Message.description_en: The returned message or failure description

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
